title: xanthophyllum lanceatum
intro: Xanthophyllum lanceatum, commonly known as the lance-leaf xanthophyllum, is a plant species belonging to the family Polygalaceae. It is a medicinal plant traditionally used in Southeast Asia, particularly in Malaysia and Indonesia, for its numerous health benefits. The plant is valued for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in relieving pain, reducing fever, and protecting against infections. The bioactive constituents of Xanthophyllum lanceatum include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in treating various health conditions.
